title: leontodon taraxacum var. palustris
intro: Leontodon taraxacum var. palustris, commonly known as marsh dandelion, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the sunflower family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of digestive issues, skin problems, and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Leontodon taraxacum var. palustris include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe irritated skin and reduce oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
